title: Keep Label Saving by Merchandise Class on Delivery Claims Wrong Items
content:
Under Delivery Claims, the charge for a wrong item the customer keeps carries a keep label saving set by the merchandise class of the line.

**Schedule.** The keep label saving depends on the merchandise class of the line: footwear takes 12.00 USD off the charge, apparel 8.00 USD, accessories 6.00 USD, and any other class nothing.

The line is the order line the wrong item came in place of; its merchandise class is the one shown on its booking line.

| Merchandise class | Keep label saving |
|---|---|
| footwear | 12.00 USD |
| apparel | 8.00 USD |
| accessories | 6.00 USD |
| any other class | none |

The saving is a fixed amount taken off the charge once, whatever the number of units kept.

*Hypothetical:* a wrong item received in place of an apparel line takes 8.00 USD off the keep charge; in place of a footwear line, 12.00 USD.
